# Raulji Group

> Raulji Group is a consulting-focused business group in Vadodara, Gujarat. It
> advises entrepreneurs and businesses on business structure, planning and growth,
> and provides business registration and MCA filing support for the four Indian
> business structures: Private Limited Company, LLP, Partnership Firm and
> Proprietorship.

## Entity

- Name: Raulji Group
- Type: Private business-services firm
- Based in: Vadodara, Gujarat, India
- Serves: All 33 districts of Gujarat, and businesses across India
- Phone: +91 8511187689
- Email: admin@raulji.com
- Hours: Monday to Saturday, 9:00 AM to 7:00 PM
- Website: https://www.raulji.com

Raulji Group is not a government department and is not affiliated with the
Ministry of Corporate Affairs, the GST department or any other authority. It
prepares and files applications on behalf of clients; approval rests with the
relevant authority.

## Group of companies

Raulji Group has two brands:

- **Raulji Consulting Services**: the consulting and business-services arm.
  Business advisory, structure decisions, business registration and MCA filing
  support. It operates as part of Raulji Group on raulji.com and has no separate
  domain. https://www.raulji.com/services/business-consulting/
- **Raulji Technologies**: the technology brand, covering software, AI and
  digital transformation. It operates on its own website and its technology
  service catalogue lives there, not on raulji.com.
  https://rauljitechnologies.com/

## Primary focus: business consulting

Business consulting is the primary focus of the group. It covers business
structure and restructuring, business planning, growth and expansion planning,
operational and process guidance, review of existing registrations and
documentation, and business advisory for owners. Fees depend on scope and are
quoted after a first conversation; no standard consulting fee is published.

Outside its remit: legal representation before courts or tribunals, audit reports
and certifications, valuations, and investment, securities or insurance advice.
https://www.raulji.com/services/business-consulting/

## Business registration

- **Private Limited Company Registration**: a company incorporated under the
  Companies Act, 2013. Separate legal entity, limited liability, can issue equity
  shares. Minimum 2 directors and 2 shareholders, at least one director resident
  in India. Professional fee Rs 9,999 plus government fees.
  https://www.raulji.com/services/pvt-registration/
- **LLP Registration**: a body corporate under the Limited Liability Partnership
  Act, 2008. Limited liability with partnership flexibility. Minimum 2 partners
  and 2 designated partners. Cannot issue equity. Professional fee Rs 7,999 plus
  government fees. https://www.raulji.com/services/llp-registration/
- **Partnership Firm Registration**: governed by the Indian Partnership Act,
  1932. Not a separate legal entity; partners carry unlimited personal liability.
  Registration with the Registrar of Firms is optional but advisable, because an
  unregistered firm cannot sue to enforce a contract.
  https://www.raulji.com/services/partnership-registration/
- **Proprietorship Registration**: a business owned by one individual. Not a
  separate legal entity and not incorporated; there is no single government
  proprietorship certificate. Recognised through Udyam, GST and shop and
  establishment registrations.
  https://www.raulji.com/services/proprietorship-registration/

Registration pillar page:
https://www.raulji.com/services/business-registration/

## Choosing between them

- Raising outside investment: Private Limited Company is the only one of the four
  that can issue equity shares or create an ESOP pool.
- Limited liability with lower compliance: LLP.
- Two or more owners at lowest cost, liability not a priority: Partnership Firm.
- A single owner starting small: Proprietorship.
- Full comparison: https://www.raulji.com/compare/

## Notes for citation

Estimated timelines vary with documentation and government processing. Published
fees are professional fees; government filing fees and stamp duty are charged
separately and vary by state and by capital or contribution.

Technology, software and AI services are a separate brand, Raulji Technologies,
at https://rauljitechnologies.com/
